claudeReadyContextPayload.contextSummary:
Tenant: meridian-health
Module: moves
Purpose: phase_readiness
Finance Analytics context assembled for moves (analytics_modernization): 5 evidence refs are available; all remain synthetic review evidence until tenant validation and promotion.
Profiles: enterprise:Meridian Health; function:Finance Analytics; use_case:Finance analytics modernization across close reporting, managed analytics services, and spend insight; system:Oracle ERP Finance; system:Workday Finance and HR source feeds; system:Netezza finance analytics appliance; system:SQL Server Finance Mart; system:Informatica Finance ETL
Key facts: pain_point=Month-end close dashboards slow down because 38 priority reports refresh from five SQL Server finance schemas during the same overnight load window.; pain_point=Vendor spend differs across AP, procurement, and contract repository extracts, so sourcing questions need a reconciled vendor-master rule before Source uses the data.; pain_point=FP&A trusts 42 certified dashboards, but business-unit teams still use 300+ Excel extracts copied from legacy Tableau views.; pain_point=Informatica job failures are resolved manually because the finance mart lacks clear lineage from Oracle ERP subledger jobs to report-level consumers.; pain_point=Databricks Finance Gold is the target path, but cost-center hierarchy, vendor master harmonization, and audit signoff are unresolved.; metric=Close report refresh completion by 6:00 AM CT; metric=Certified finance dashboard adoption; metric=Manual reconciliation hours per close cycle
Relationships: depends_on:Finance Analytics connects to Meridian Health for the analytics_modernization request.; uses:Finance Analytics connects to Finance analytics modernization across close reporting, managed analytics services, and spend insight for the analytics_modernization request.; depends_on:Finance Analytics connects to Oracle ERP Finance for the analytics_modernization request.; uses:Finance Analytics connects to Workday Finance and HR source feeds for the analytics_modernization request.; depends_on:Finance Analytics connects to Netezza finance analytics appliance for the analytics_modernization request.; uses:Finance Analytics connects to SQL Server Finance Mart for the analytics_modernization request.; depends_on:Finance Analytics connects to Informatica Finance ETL for the analytics_modernization request.; uses:Finance Analytics connects to Tableau and Power BI finance dashboards for the analytics_modernization request.
Metrics: Close report refresh completion by 6:00 AM CT; Certified finance dashboard adoption; Manual reconciliation hours per close cycle
Risks/controls: inconsistent vendor spend definitions; slow close-window dashboards; manual reconciliation control risk
Evidence summary: Oracle ERP Finance GL/AP/AR extract as of 2026-06 synthetic close cycle.; SQL Server Finance Mart schema inventory showing GL, AP, AR, budget, vendor spend, and cost-center schemas.; Informatica finance ETL inventory with 200 nightly jobs and close-window failure notes.; Tableau and Power BI finance dashboard inventory with certified vs shadow-report split.; Finance Gold Data Product design notes for Databricks target certification.
Confidence: good - The cluster has enough semantic depth for dry-run context assembly, but remains synthetic review context with candidate relationship edges.
Known gaps: inconsistent vendor spend definitions; slow close-window dashboards; incomplete lineage from ERP to BI; Relationship candidates are preserved for context assembly, but are not treated as validated active graph truth.
Recommended next evidence: source-owner attestation; measured baseline extract; relationship validation; operator promotion review
